ios.desc:
TwinCam uses both front and back cameras to create a single selfie. 

Unique benefits:

1. No need to turn around to take selfies. The selfie-taker's image is captured using the front camera and overlayed on top of the back camera's image.
2. Size of selfie-taker's face is adjustable. You can leave your selfie stick at home from now on. 
3. Higher quality background because of better lenses at the back
4. Better lighting for both foreground (selfie-taker) and background
5. Both foreground AND background images are in focus!
6. You can even re-frame the background independently after you have captured the perfect foreground pose.

[Front image capture works with a single person and a group of people]
[TwinCam is supported on iPhone XS or later and iPads]
[Photo Credits: https://www.instagram.com/kwoksdine https://www.instagram.com/kwokspots]

android.desc:
TwinCam is a powerful dual camera application that allows you to capture photos using both front and rear cameras simultaneously. 

Features:
- Dual camera capture
- Real-time face detection
- Advanced image processing
- Easy sharing and saving
- Intuitive user interface

Perfect for creating unique photos with both perspectives in one shot.
